backend/main.mo: Motoko canister providing user profile storage with authorization checks and per-user fill-up tracking including add and query operations.
feature_evidence.json: Report mapping feature changes to affected frontend files, components, and test IDs for traceability.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Collection of short summaries describing the purpose and behavior of each frontend file.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based OKLCH color system and layout variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/index.html: HTML app entry point defining metadata and loading the main React bundle with Breeza Mileage branding.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component routing users to onboarding, profile setup, or the dashboard based on authentication and profile state.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button wired to Internet Identity with cache clearing and edge-case handling.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Dashbo: Dashboard view showing Breeza Mileage header, stats, filters, and fill-up list with loading and error states.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/FillUp: Renders fill-up entries with formatted units, badges, and efficiency metrics or an empty-state card.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Filter: UI controls for filtering and sorting fill-up entries by date range and order.
frontend/src/components/fillups/FillUpFo: Form component for adding fill-up data with validation, unit conversion, and actor readiness checks.
frontend/src/components/fillups/MileageS: Displays averaged, best, worst mileage, and total distance stats from recorded fill-ups.
frontend/src/components/help/HelpContent: Provides instructional text explaining mileage calculation, tips, and stat definitions.
Dialog component that displays help content with a trigger button.
App layout wrapper with header, footer, user greeting, help dialog, and login button.
frontend/src/components/onboarding/Onboa: Landing screen introducing features, showing hero content, and prompting login.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileS: Dialog for creating a user profile with name and unit system selection.
frontend/src/features/dashboard/filterin: Provides date-range and sort-order utilities for filtering and sorting fill-up entries.
frontend/src/features/fillups/types.ts: Defines types for fill-up entries and form data, including optional computed fields.
frontend/src/features/fillups/useFillUps: Provides React Query hooks to fetch and add fuel fill-up records, transforming backend data and computing derived metrics.
frontend/src/features/fillups/validation: Validates fill-up form inputs, ensuring odometer and fuel values are numeric and logically consistent.
frontend/src/features/profile/useUserPro: Defines hooks to load, save, and fetch the current user's profile and role via actor calls.
frontend/src/features/units/units.ts: Contains helpers for returning unit labels and formatting efficiency, distance, and fuel in metric or imperial systems.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's identity, refreshing dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity auth context with login, logout, identity loading, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Empty placeholder file noting that queries are organized in feature-specific hooks.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind setup defining light and dark theme variables with warm color tones.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point configuring React Query and Internet Identity provider before rendering the root app.
frontend/src/utils/actorError.ts: Normalizes actor call errors into user-friendly messages with structured debugging details.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading, storing, persisting, and clearing URL and session-based parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS config enabling dark mode, custom OKLCH-based theme colors, extended animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing an Android mileage-tracking app, including features, known issues, and versioned project state.
